svg.title: Kernel and layer suite by family and by precision
svg.desc: Geomean of Mapal time divided by the fastest same-precision competitor's time, per group and GPU.
svg.text: Kernel and layer suite by family and by precision
Geomean of Mapal time ÷ the fastest competitor's time at the row's own precision; below 1 (blue): Mapal faster. Rows per GPU in brackets.
A count after a value: that GPU timed fewer rows of the group. fp8-weight rows have no competitor leg yet and are left out. Data: benches/results/evidence/matrix.json.
